name: Eva Petropoulou-Lianou

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Eva Petropoulou-Lianou is a Greek writer from Xylokastro whose work includes poetry and books for children. Her published biography also describes her involvement in bringing Greek poets to wider literary audiences.

Her poems in Kabita Live speak directly to the reader. ‘Fallen Angel’ addresses people hurt by bullying or damaging relationships, asking them to recover their sense of worth and their capacity to help others. ‘Sun’ finds a gentler image for generosity in sunlight itself. Together, the poems place compassion in everyday acts of attention, encouragement and care.
